title: Juicy Indian White Fish Fillets Pakora
description: A sour and crunchy Indian dish featuring white fish fillets in a pakora form, made with bhuna spices and cooked on a tava griddle, suitable for halal diets.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the gram flour, bhuna spice mix, and salt.
Add the lemon juice and water to the bowl and stir until a smooth batter forms.
Cut the white fish fillets into small pieces and add them to the batter, mixing until they are fully coated.
Heat the ghee or oil in a large tava griddle over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the fish batter onto the griddle and flatten slightly.
Cook the pakora for 3-4 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the pakora from the griddle and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Garnish the pakora with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
